token_set.name: Stanley Cup 2026
token_set.description:
In the NHL, one of the league’s most treasured traditions is that each player and key staff member from the Stanley Cup–winning team gets to spend an entire day with the Cup. It’s a rare chance to celebrate with loved ones and hometown communities in creative and meaningful ways. Whether it’s taking the Cup fishing, eating cereal out of it, or bringing it to hospitals and local rinks, this legendary trophy has traveled the globe and been part of countless unforgettable stories. It’s a personal reward that makes capturing the Stanley Cup even more special—and undeniably legendary.
The Day with the Cup collectible celebrates that tradition, capturing the emotion, pride, and thrill of raising hockey’s most iconic trophy. Featuring players past and present, it’s a tribute to the legacy of champions. If you had the Cup for a day, how would you spend it?
